notes:
POC objective: validate Private VPC deployment pattern (Terraform + Helm) and prove integration with customer-managed KMS and audit/logging pipeline. Scope: deploy Redwood Private control plane components (control-plane proxy only) in Archon Vela's EU AWS account, attach to their KMS CMK, verify audit logs forwarded to Splunk/central ELK, and run full inference smoke/integration tests against a production-like model (quantized open model).

POC deliverables:
- Terraform modules for VPC networking, subnets, SGs, and IAM roles (customer-owned).
- Helm chart values and a runbook for install/upgrade.
- Integration test suite: connectivity, end-to-end inference, KMS envelope encryption test, audit log verification, SSO (SAML) login flow.
- Sign-off checklist with latency/throughput and security criteria.

Success metrics (customer): p50 latency <200ms for 256-token chat requests, sustain 150 rps on reserved pool, audit logs available in Splunk within 60s, keys never leave customer KMS, data residency enforced (EU only). Cost sensitivity: wants unit cost to be within 20% of their current self-hosted infra.

Customer quotes from CTO Marta Lind: "We cannot expose raw payment metadata outside EU boundaries; KMS control is non-negotiable." From Head of Infra: "We want the templates to be reusable — we will gate acceptance on IaC quality and Terraform state handling."

Current technical status: Terraform/Helm artifacts are in PR; smoke tests show promising latency but audit log forwarding permissions block remains. KMS policy needs to allow Redwood runtime principal to encrypt/decrypt with CMK via a cross-account grant pattern — security team drafting final policy.

Risk items: network egress rules for metrics/observability, retention-policy disagreement (legal wants shorter retention), and an internal procurement cycle that may push to Q3 if not signed in April.

Recommended next actions: 1) Assist customer infra to craft KMS grant template (SE action). 2) Patch audit logging permission flow and re-run audit forwarding test. 3) Deliver sign-off checklist and schedule canary cutover in week 3. 4) Deliver short runbook for Terraform state (S3 backend + locking).
